status: prospective gate only; not a Dorabella plaintext search
basis: Mechanical interpretation of direction and arc count; round9 section4.1 explicitly leaves wrapping open. No historical evidence for this particular board is claimed.
alphabet_whitespace: remove spaces; j->i and v->u already applied to archived known texts
direction_keys: s in {-1,1}, h in 0..7 (16 relabellings, identical reachable displacement SET)
state: one cell of board; add displacement modulo width and height; emit endpoint letter
starts: all 24 cells; same initial cell for all row resets
inverse: all original glyph IDs whose displacement connects previous cell to next cell; empty set means unencodable. No preferred member, null, insert, deletion or correction.
input: 14 unchanged old_positive_truth.json plaintexts, all 87 letters; already seen, not blind
gate: For each text exhaustively test whether at least one model key admits a complete 87-glyph encoding. At least12/14 complete representability is required to justify designing an end-to-end search calibration. This is a practical sensitivity requirement, not a hypothesis-test significance threshold and not proof that any rejected family cannot encode Dorabella.
immutable_evaluation: number of empty inverse sets over all87 positions; success only zero. No English scorer, maximization on ciphertext, or plaintext editing.
budget: 14*1152=16128 reachability patterns, 1403136 position checks; logical direction factor16 gives18432 key definitions/text. Every position checked even after failure.
controls: Implementation positives: deterministic 87-glyph walks in every one of1152 board/start/read/reset settings, decoded then tested for membership of every generating glyph in inverse sets. Implementation negatives: an unreachable displacement for every shape/layout, checked empty. These are code controls, not language recovery or statistical null controls.
stop: If fewer than12 known texts are representable, stop this candidate. No real Dorabella inputs, no null generation or scoring, no solver. If passed, stop for a separately frozen full search protocol with matched real/null search and positive recovery; representability alone never authorizes a scientific success claim.
acceptance: No decipherment can be accepted in this gate. Any later candidate requires all87 signs and exact inverse membership plus independent evidence; reverse encoding alone is not historical proof.
no_repeat: Compare round9 section4.1 literal_walk.py (explicitly no wrap), round6 sections3,5,7 (affine mod24, local component transforms then heuristic substitution, coordinate fractionation). No old solvers run. Some parameter settings may coincide with old outputs; no claim of disjoint sets of possible strings.
